root_cause.text: The `qfq_reset_qdisc` function incorrectly infers class activity from the shared leaf qdisc's queue length instead of the class's own active state, triggering a NULL pointer dereference when multiple QFQ instances share the same leaf qdisc.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `net/sched/sch_qfq.c` to replace the condition `cl->qdisc->q.qlen > 0` with `cl_is_active(cl)` in `qfq_reset_qdisc`, directly addressing the CVE description which states that `qfq_class->leaf_qdisc->q.qlen > 0` does not imply the class itself is active because two `qfq_class` objects may point to the same `leaf_qdisc`.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement incorrectly determines class activity based on the shared leaf qdisc's queue length (cl->qdisc->q.qlen) rather than the class's own active state. In scenarios where multiple QFQ instances share the same leaf qdisc, this logic causes incorrect deactivation decisions that can lead to a NULL pointer dereference during reset operations.
